text.tspan: Queued means accepted work, not a result.
Poll the exact run to a terminal state.
never blindly resend. Acceptance is not inbox delivery.
explicit POST verifies. Return capability is checked
against live access and consent on every guest request.
[Guest enables reminders on a real invitation]
and shows a Retry status button.

svg.text: intent_key per home, replay if already seen
enqueue tick run per due job, not opportunistic
drainAgentQueue: queued or stale running (6 min),
claim source + contact generation with lease
under home lock recheck consent, access,
tool call, policy hook first for gated tools
read, or authorized write, plus audit row
one automatic attempt, explicit retry after failure
verify current host, home and completed capture run
private link in action result only
explicit consent POST, typed address or verified Google identity
scoped contact generation and verification outbox
